spec.text:
How to build from this canvas

• Shell, tokens and components are the Electron app's (docs/design/DS-691). Geist / Geist Mono, shadcn zinc, light theme drawn; the dark tokens sit in each board's style block.
• Every value is in the board CSS: copy px, colours and radii from there, not from the screenshot.
• Each board's strip names its route, the view.json slice it reads and its ticket area.
• Numbers: real from view.json of 28 Nov where the page has them; lever counts are Jim's raw counts, i.e. what the page shows once the evidence fix lands. Guardrail estimates on board 4 and before/after figures marked 'sample' are sample numbers.
• One term per idea: being tested · ready to decide · kept · off · on by hand · before levers · change.
• Never print 0 for a number desk doesn't have: print — and say why.
• Never print shell commands, file paths, test emails or Jira field IDs in body copy. The Inbox 'Runs:' footnote is the one exception (DS-691 §11b.3).
